name: Nyarbalte
source: Nyarbalte is an ancient and forgotten god of the swamps. For the small price of spilled blood at the crossroads the god will grant you any desire. Nyarbalte does not care for human nuances, and doesn't mind if the blood was given on accident or on purpose. The Myyr dimension is Nyarbalte's domain.
